blocks.en: Let $X$ and $Y$ be Banach spaces. The following three theorems on operators from $X$ to $Y$ have important consequences in our attempts to invert operators.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 和 $Y$ 为 Banach 空间. 以下关于从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的算子的三个定理, 对算子的求逆具有重要意义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, and suppose $A$ is surjective (onto). Then the image of every open set $S\subset X$ is open in $Y$.
blocks.zh: 设 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, 并假设 $A$ 为满射 (映满). 那么每个开集 $S\subset X$ 的像在 $Y$ 中都是开集.
blocks.label: thm:open-mapping

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, and suppose $A$ is bijective (one-to-one and onto). Then the inverse map $A^{-1}$ is bounded.
blocks.zh: 设 $A\in\mathcal{L}(X,Y)$, 并假设 $A$ 为双射 (一一且映满). 那么逆映射 $A^{-1}$ 有界.
blocks.label: thm:bounded-inverse

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ be a linear operator from $X$ to $Y$. Then if $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ is a closed operator and its domain $\mathcal{D}(A)$ is closed in $X$, then the operator is bounded.
blocks.zh: 设 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是从 $X$ 到 $Y$ 的线性算子. 若 $(\mathcal{D}(A),A)$ 是闭算子, 且其定义域 $\mathcal{D}(A)$ 在 $X$ 中是闭的, 则该算子有界.
blocks.label: thm:closed-graph

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: In a typical course in functional analysis, the open mapping theorem is proved using the Baire category theorem, and the bounded inverse theorem and closed graph theorem are derived as consequences. In fact, as we show in Lemma~\ref{lem:three-operator-theorems-equivalence} below, all three theorems are equivalent. Furthermore, after we have developed the machinery of adjoints in Section~\ref{sec:adjoint-operators}, we will be able to prove the bounded inverse theorem for Hilbert spaces. Since most of our applications will use Hilbert spaces, we will limit ourselves to the proof for this case and ask the reader to refer to the literature for proofs of the more general cases.
blocks.zh: 通常的泛函分析课程利用 Baire 纲定理证明开映射定理, 然后将有界逆定理和闭图定理作为推论导出. 事实上, 正如下面的 Lemma~\ref{lem:three-operator-theorems-equivalence} 将表明的, 三个定理彼此等价. 此外, 在 Section~\ref{sec:adjoint-operators} 中建立伴随算子的工具后, 就能够对 Hilbert 空间证明有界逆定理. 由于大多数应用都将使用 Hilbert 空间, 这里只证明这一情形, 更一般情形的证明请读者参阅文献.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The open mapping theorem, the bounded inverse theorem, and the closed graph theorem are equivalent.
blocks.zh: 开映射定理, 有界逆定理和闭图定理彼此等价.
blocks.label: lem:three-operator-theorems-equivalence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The proof we give here is good only if $X$ is a Hilbert space. However, the first three parts of the proof apply directly to Banach spaces, and the final part can be generalized by using equivalence classes. (This is a standard technique for getting around the lack of a projection theorem in Banach spaces, but one we won't go into in this text.)
blocks.zh: 这里给出的证明仅在 $X$ 是 Hilbert 空间时有效. 不过, 证明的前三部分直接适用于 Banach 空间, 最后一部分可以通过使用等价类来推广. (这是绕过 Banach 空间中缺少投影定理这一困难的标准技巧, 但本书不展开讨论.)
